Item: Grilled Herbed Chicken Breast with tomato bruschetta
Reheat Instructions: Reheat chicken in a skillet over medium-low heat for 3-4 minutes per side until warmed through, or in the oven at 325 degrees F covered with foil for 10-12 minutes. Serve topped with tomato bruschetta at room temperature - do not heat the bruschetta. Best enjoyed within 4 days.

For best results, reheat in the oven at 250 degrees F on a foil-covered baking sheet for 20-25 minutes until warmed through - low and slow preserves tenderness. Or reheat briefly in a skillet over medium heat for 1-2 minutes per side. Rest 2 minutes before serving. Best enjoyed within 3-4 days.

Item: Zucchini & Dill Chicken Meatballs with tzatziki sauce
Reheat Instructions: Reheat meatballs in a skillet over medium heat for 3-4 minutes, turning occasionally, or microwave covered for 60-90 seconds. Serve with tzatziki sauce cold or at room temperature - do not heat the tzatziki. Best enjoyed within 4-5 days.

Reheat in a skillet over medium heat for 2-3 minutes per side until warmed through, or in the oven at 350 degrees F on a baking sheet for 10-12 minutes. Or microwave covered for 60-90 seconds. Best enjoyed within 4 days.

Item: Pan Seared Salmon with cilantro yogurt sauce
Reheat Instructions: Reheat salmon in the oven at 275 degrees F on a foil-covered baking sheet for 10-12 minutes until just warmed through - low heat preserves moisture and prevents drying out. Serve with cilantro yogurt sauce cold or at room temperature - do not heat the sauce. Best enjoyed within 3 days.

Reheat in the oven at 400 degrees F on a baking sheet for 8-10 minutes until warmed through and edges are slightly caramelized. Or reheat in a skillet over medium heat with a drizzle of olive oil for 3-4 minutes. Best enjoyed within 4-5 days.

Reheat in the microwave with a damp paper towel on top for 60-90 seconds, stirring halfway through. Or heat in a small saucepan over medium-low heat with a splash of water for 2-3 minutes. Best enjoyed within 5 days.

Reheat in a saucepan over medium-low heat with a splash of broth or water for 3-5 minutes, stirring occasionally. Or microwave covered for 60-90 seconds, stirring halfway through. Best enjoyed within 5 days.

For best texture, reheat in the oven at 400 degrees F on a baking sheet for 8-10 minutes until re-crisped. Or reheat in an air fryer at 375 degrees F for 4-5 minutes. Avoid the microwave - it softens the crispy exterior. Best enjoyed within 4 days.

Item: Chopped Salad with black beans, corn, cherry tomatoes, red onions, queso fresco & cumin-lime vinaigrette
Reheat Instructions: Serve chilled or at room temperature - no reheating needed. Toss well before serving and drizzle vinaigrette just before eating to keep everything fresh. Best enjoyed within 3 days.

Item: Baby Spinach Salad with turkey bacon, roasted mushrooms, red onions, cherry tomatoes, goat cheese & balsamic vinaigrette
Reheat Instructions: Serve chilled or at room temperature - no reheating needed. Toss well before serving and dress just before eating to keep the spinach fresh. Best enjoyed within 2-3 days.
